plans.goal: Burn the ambush and drive them into our blades with fire and chaos
steps: Ignite the cart to control the center and scatter their formation
Maud anchors back safely; Borin holds the left flank against Fitch
Pip flanks through the brush while I push forward to isolate their leader

atoms.strategy: ignite central prop for control and damage
atoms.text: I'll ignite the handcart at the center — watch for the flames
Maud, hold back by the trees — you're no good to us if you're stabbed

atoms.strategy: deny left flank and block skirmisher
atoms.text: Borin, hold the left by the barrel — stop Fitch cold

atoms.strategy: outflank the archer from high ground
atoms.text: Pip, swing north through the brush and get behind that archer

atoms.strategy: collapse on leader after chaos settles
atoms.text: Once the fire spreads, everyone on Col — he's the strongest and I want him first

plans.goal: Isolate and eliminate Nell the archer, then crush the brutes in detail
steps: Silence the archer before she can rain arrows on us
Use the log-pile as a trap when they bunch up chasing
Sweep up the remaining brutes before they coordinate

atoms.text: Nell on the high ground is dangerous — everyone, focus the archer before she finds her range
I'm falling back toward the log-pile — if Col and Fitch chase, they're walking into it

atoms.strategy: trigger set piece when enemies converge
atoms.text: If they bunch up by the road, cut the log-pile loose and let gravity do the work
Maud, don't move from where you are — Borin and I will keep the chaos away from you

atoms.strategy: crush remaining foes after archer falls
atoms.text: Pip, once Nell is down, we collapse on the left flank — finish the brutes before they break

plans.goal: Provoke the bees nest to scatter their formation, then pick off isolated targets
steps: Knock down the nest from range to flood the area with chaos
Let confusion settle for one breath, then identify isolated prey
Drive wedges between them and finish them one by one

atoms.text: Knock down the bees' nest — let them sting everyone within two tiles, exposed or hidden
Pip, exploit the confusion — roll through the middle while they're swatting insects
Maud, if the fight comes your way, Borin shields you — don't get separated
Once the chaos clears, everyone focuses Fitch — a skirmisher is easier to break than a brute

atoms.strategy: press wounded enemy while advantage holds
atoms.text: If any of them are rattled or slowed, I push hard before they rally
